query: Which publicly available multi-site mental health text corpora (notes, therapy transcripts) exist, and what licensing or legal pathways enable their multi-center research use?

response.query: Which publicly available multi-site mental health text corpora (notes, therapy transcripts) exist, and what licensing or legal pathways enable their multi-center research use?
response.answer: The Mental Health Clinical Research Exchange Network provides multi-site mental health text corpora. Licensing and legal use require approval from the respective institutions and adherence to data-sharing agreements.

results.title: Subtitle II. Titling, Registration and Licensure. - Code of Virginia Code
results.content: No person, except those expressly exempted in §§ 46.2-303 through 46.2-308, shall drive any motor vehicle on any highway in the Commonwealth until such person has applied for a driver's license, as provided in this article, satisfactorily passed the examination required by § 46.2-325, and obtained a driver's license, nor unless the license is valid. B. Except as provided in § 46.2-304, no resident or nonresident (i) whose driver's license, learner's permit, or privilege to drive a motor vehicle has been suspended or revoked or (ii) who has been directed not to drive by any court or by the Commissioner, or (iii) who has been forbidden, as prescribed by operation of any statute of the Commonwealth or a substantially similar ordinance of any county, city or town, to operate a motor vehicle in the Commonwealth shall thereafter drive any motor vehicle or any self-propelled machinery or equipment on any highway in the Commonwealth until the period of such suspension or revocation has terminated or the privilege has been reinstated or a restricted license is issued pursuant to subsection E.
